title: Agencies deny Grusch access to programs

tellings.quote: went to the agencies that wrote those reports and asked for access. And when I when when they deny you access then you know it's a thing.

plain: Between 2019 and 2022, a former intelligence officer named David Grusch went to the agencies that had written certain reports and asked to be let into the secret programs those reports pointed to, and they turned him down. Grusch, who later testified to Congress, tells Michels this happened to him, and that "when they deny you access then you know it's a thing". To him, the refusal itself was a sign the programs exist.
